statement: Let (T, B + β) be an effective compact Kähler gklt pair of dimension d, with T globally strongly Q-factorial. Suppose that its nef b-data are globally nef on a fixed smooth carrier and that {B}+βT is globally modified big. Write α = {KT +B}+βT . (i) If α is nef, there is a proper morphism with connected fibers g : T → Z to a normal compact Kähler space and a Kähler class ωZ such that α = g∗ωZ. (ii) For a proper morphism π : T → V to a normal compact Kähler space, if α is pseudo-effective over V , there is a chosen good log terminal model over V . It is nonextracting, compact Kähler and globally strongly Q-factorial. Its adjoint is nef over V , and on a common projective resolution its comparison with α is effective and exceptional over the new model, with strictly positive coefficient at every prime contracted from T. The construction retains compatible forward Bott–Chern traces of the specified data on a common smooth carrier. 15 (iii) A compact polytope of these data on one fixed carrier has finitely many marked relative canonical models and relative weak log canonical models with normal compact Kähler targets. The relative assertion applies to proper morphisms, without assuming that π is projective. It is an assertion about a chosen model, not termination of every generalized flip sequence.
